captions.detailed: An urban commuter bicycle front fork assembly featuring a dark green fork with straight blades, a brazed crown, and blocky dropouts holding a silver front axle. A black low-rider front rack with a flat platform is mounted to the mid-blade points via thin support struts. A long silver quill stem rises from the steerer tube to clamp a curved riser handlebar equipped with black hand grips. The steering system articulates via a continuous rotational joint around the central steerer tube axis.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an urban commuter bicycle front fork assembly. It should include a dark green fork with straight blades and box dropouts, a front-mounted black low-rider rack with a flat platform, and a silver quill stem holding a riser handlebar with black grips. Ensure the entire handlebar, stem, and fork assembly rotates continuously around the steering axis relative to a central frame headtube placeholder.
captions.factory: The model is constructed by defining three main parts: a fixed frame headtube placeholder, a rotating steering assembly, and a front wheel axle. The steering assembly is built using a series of cylinder primitives for the steerer tube, fork crown, straight blades, and the quill stem, combined with swept paths or extruded circles for the curved riser handlebar. The front low-rider rack is modeled using a thin box for the flat platform and cylinders for its supporting struts. A continuous joint is established along the Z-axis of the headtube to allow the steering assembly to rotate freely.
